messages:
elaine: Customer Acme reports 400s for tool calls after last-night rename. They call `summarize_v2` and get schema validation error. They say SDK didn't change.

elaine: curl + payload they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"summarize_v2","input":"long doc..."}'
```

elaine: response:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":"schema_validation_error","message":"unknown tool handle 'summarize_v2'","request_id":"req_01GxJ..."}
```

ricardo: looked at registry, we renamed canonical handle to `summarize-v2` (dash) last night as part of naming standardization. alias for underscore not created for tenant `acme`.

ricardo: likely cause = client still using old handle + alias omission + cache TTL on edge. can repro locally with same payload.

tara: is there fallback configured to try old handles? should have tolerated underscores -> dashes mapping.

infra-bot: registry lookup for tenant acme:
```
{ "handle": "summarize-v2", "aliases": [], "tombstone": false }
```
edge-cache: alias-mapping TTL 3600s, last refresh 02:12 UTC
```

ricardo: quick mitigation options:
- create alias mapping `summarize_v2` -> `summarize-v2` for tenant acme (safe)
- patch proxy to accept underscore/dash normalization for 24h
- push client-side hotfix but that takes longer

ricardo: backfill command I ran in staging (redwoodctl):
```
redwoodctl registry alias create --tenant acme --alias summarize_v2 --target summarize-v2
```

ricardo: reproduction steps (local):
1) run proxy-local
2) curl as above
3) see `400 unknown tool handle 'summarize_v2'` in proxy logs
4) apply alias create -> requests start routing to canonical handle

elaine: can we get the alias created ASAP? customer is hitting errors in production and has an SLA ticket.

ricardo: I'm creating alias in prod now and will invalidate edge cache. Doing canary first (10% traffic) then global.

tara: create PR for long-term fix (normalize incoming handles casefold + punctuation map). link it here.

ricardo: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3245
- adds normalization layer in proxy
- adds integration test for underscores/dashes

ricardo: deploying canary in 30m. I'll post deploy id and monitor token-level 500/400 rates.

elaine: thanks — I'll update Acme with temporary workaround and ETA. please drop request_id when you have it so I can correlate.

ricardo: deploy id: canary-2026-03-17-07. request_id from failing call: req_01GxJxyz (i've attached logs to the ticket)

elaine: noted, updating customer. :thumbsup:

tara: follow-up action: schedule registry alias audit and add migration backfill for other tenants that might rely on old handles.

elaine: added to incident log and created follow-up task in /incidents: INC-4921

infra-bot: alias created in prod: summarize_v2 -> summarize-v2, cache invalidated at 2267001400

ricardo: 10m after canary metrics look good. 400s -> 200s for acme calls.

elaine: closing escalation with customer, monitoring for 24h. thanks everyone.
